description: This file defines validation primitives and error handling for protocol message validation in the Playwright project, including various validator functions for primitive types, complex objects, and validation schemes.

classes.name: ValidationError
classes.description: Custom error class for validation errors.

methods.name: findValidator
methods.description: Retrieves a validator for a specific type, method, and kind, throws if not found.

methods.name: maybeFindValidator
methods.description: Attempts to find a validator for a specific type, method, and kind, returns undefined if not found.

methods.name: createMetadataValidator
methods.description: Creates a validator for optional Metadata scheme.
